title: Law to create a Storefront Business Bill of Rights
summary: This bill would require written leases for storefront tenants renting for more than one year and set procedures for lease renewal negotiations, including timelines for renewal offers and a one-time lease extension option of up to one year with a rent increase capped at 10 percent. It would also require landlords to disclose information such as certificates of occupancy, past utility and tax costs, and violation histories before signing a lease. The Department of Small Business Services would oversee compliance and offer model leases and translations, with courts able to impose civil penalties for violations.
